create_sampler_from_config: create a Sampler instance from a config dict using Sampler.from_config
build_choice_sampler: build a ChoiceSampler that samples values uniformly or with weights from a list or dict
create_uniform_sampler: create a UniformSampler that samples float values from a uniform distribution between low and high bounds
build_uniformint_sampler: build a UniformIntSampler that samples integer values from a uniform distribution between low and high bounds
create_tuple_sampler: create a TupleSampler that samples a tuple of values from a collection of nested samplers
